name: Tsukishima
text: Tsukishima (月島; Japanese pronunciation: [tsɯ̥.kʲi.ɕi.ma]) is a place located in Chūō, Tokyo, Japan, in the Sumida River estuary. It is a reclaimed land next to Tsukuda District. The land reclamation completed in 1892, using earth from the dredging work performed to create a shipping channel in Tokyo Bay.

depictions.text: Tsukishima 月島 is a location in Persona 5.
